messages:
mike: deploy-bot paused the eu-west1 canary, preflight timeout during node maintenance. can someone take a look?

deploy-bot: automated: Canary paused for release v2.14.0 (chart 2.14.0-rc3). Reason: preflight timeout (readiness) on 2/3 replicas. Action required: manual review. Link: https://deploy.redwood/release/2.14.0

sre-oncall: saw the node-evac job at 13:58 UTC. kubelet started evicting pods on n1-standard-16-xx. scheduling delays + image pull spikes. looks transient but the canary hit the readiness timeout.

anita: is the chart bump included for the DB migration? i remember 2.14 had the migration hook. if we continue a partial rollout we might leave schema mismatches.

mike: yes, chart 2.14.0-rc3 includes a preflight migration hook: global.migrate=true by default. that's why i'm worried about half-applied migrations.

leah: strong +1 to avoid partial migration. i propose we pin the release to chart 2.13.9 for the rest of eu-west1 and re-run the migration during the next maintenance window.

paul: alternative: rollforward if canary completes after node drains, with an explicit migration lock around the hook. we could flip migration to manual and run it with a job that checks primary-readiness. tradeoff: delays and more manual steps.

mike: quick status/logs from the canary -- copy below:
```
[I] 13:59:12 preflight: running readiness checks
[I] 14:00:03 pod/test-canary-0 CrashLoopBackOff
[W] 14:01:10 kubelet: Preemption/eviction in progress on node eu-west1-b-xx
[E] 14:02:12 preflight: timeout waiting for all replicas to be Ready (2/3)
```

anita: ok. because migration is involved i prefer pin+hotfix. pinning process: set HelmRelease annotation `release.redwood/pin: 2.13.9`, promote image tag 2.14.0 -> 2.13.9-hotfix if needed, and open a migration runbook ticket.

paul: if we pin, we should also ensure traffic split/feature flags don't depend on the new schema. any runtime feature gates?

leah: nothing critical depends on the new schema yet — feature flag gating was planned but not enabled in eu-west. i'll double-check but low risk.

sre-oncall: operational note: node maintenance finishes 14:30 UTC, we can try a canary recheck after that. pinning now prevents accidental migration while nodes are flapping.

mike: concrete tie-breaker for this change window:
- if deploy-bot detects >90% replica readiness within 20m after maintenance end -> allow automatic rollforward (keep migration enabled)
- otherwise -> pin to 2.13.9 for eu-west1 and schedule manual migration in the 02:00 UTC window tomorrow

anita: sounds good. who will apply the pin annotation and update release notes?

leah: i'll apply the pin and update release-notes PR (spinning up branch now). i'll also add a NOTE in the release notes about deferred migration and the manual job name.

paul: i'll create the migration runbook and a one-click job for the manual migration. will link it in the PR.

deploy-bot: automated: Pin annotation applied to Release v2.14.0 for eu-west1 by leah. Canary remains paused.

mike: thanks. action items: leah -> pin + release notes, paul -> migration runbook + job, anita -> monitor for rollback indicators and confirm no feature flags in flight, sre-oncall -> re-evaluate canary after 14:30 UTC and report.

leah: noted. putting a thumbs-up in the release PR and tagging QA to hold regression checks until pin confirmed. :+1:

anita: marking this thread for the release-triage checklist. good catch on the node maintenance.

sre-oncall: i'll post an update at 14:35 UTC after the maintenance window.

mike: perfect. thanks everyone.

(emoji reactions: mike :eyes:, leah :white_check_mark:, anita :hammer_and_wrench:)
